{{page request header|User page requests}}
'''User pages''' are pages for personal use &mdash; Users often use these pages for personal projects, wiki syntax testing, etc.

===Notes:===
* '''If you are requesting your own, top-level user page (i.e. not a subpage), use''' <code><nowiki>{{upr|~~~}}</nowiki></code> to place a request easily (remember to add it at the top of the list, followed by a newline). 
* For subpages (such as sandboxes), use <code>[<nowiki/>[User:''Your username''/''subpage name'']]</code>. Remember to include the slash!
